class.name: OverworldSprite
class.brief_description: [color=green](User creatable)[/color] A specialized AnimatedSprite2D for overworld characters that automatically sets up required animations and manages alert positioning.
class.description:
[OverworldSprite] is a specialized version of [AnimatedSprite2D] designed for use in overworld character systems. It automatically creates the standard animation set required for character movement and provides alert positioning functionality.
[b]Automatic Animation Setup[/b] The sprite automatically creates the following animations when used in the editor: • "act" - Special action animation • "idle_down", "idle_side", "idle_up" - Idle animations for different directions • "move_down", "move_side", "move_up" - Movement animations for different directions
[b]Alert System[/b] The sprite manages positioning for alert indicators (like exclamation marks) that appear above characters during interactions or encounters. The [member alert_offset] property allows fine-tuning of alert positioning.
[b]Integration with OverworldCharacterNode[/b] This sprite is typically used as a child of [OverworldCharacterNode], which handles animation state management, movement, and interaction logic. The character node automatically switches between idle and movement animations based on character state.
[en] For a more detailed explanation, please refer to the tutorials linked below. [ko] 이것보다 더 자세한 설명(또는 한국어 문서)은 아래 링크된 튜토리얼을 참고하세요.

members.member: Offset position for alert indicators relative to the sprite. This determines where alert symbols (like exclamation marks) appear when the character triggers encounters or interactions. Default value places alerts 10 pixels above the sprite's position. Positive Y values move the alert down, negative values move it up.
